items.raw_excerpt: ĐNO - Cụ Huỳnh Thúc Kháng từng sống tại làng Phú Bình, ngôi làng yên bình, rợp bóng tre xanh, đêm về hắt hiu bóng đèn mù u.
items.summary_en: A Da Nang newspaper visits Phu Binh, a quiet village where green bamboo casts soft shadows at night. The writer remembers Huy Thuc Khang, a respected old man who once lived there. People in the village still keep his old lamp and wooden sandal as a warm memory.
items.summary_ko: 다낭의 한 신문이 밤마다 초록 대나무 그림자가 드리우는 고요한 마을 푸빈을 찾아갑니다. 이곳에 한때 살던 흰 투트 캉에 대한 오랜 기억을 되짚습니다. 마을 사람들은 그가 남긴 등불과 나무 신을 아직 소중히 간직하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: A Hurricane Lamp, a Wooden Sandal, and Old Memories in Phu Binh Village
items.title_ko: 푸빈 마을의 등불과 나무 신, 힌 투트 캉의 추억
items.title_original: Đèn bão, guốc mộc và ký ức cụ Huỳnh ở làng Phú Bình - Báo Đà Nẵng

items.raw_excerpt: Did you know that you could save €1,310 a year on grocery shopping if you pick the right supermarket in Spain? Here are the most affordable options in the country in 2026, and the most expensive.
items.summary_en: You can save about 1,310 euros a year on groceries by choosing the right supermarket in Spain. A new2026 price check shows which stores are the cheapest and which are the most expensive.
items.summary_ko: 스페인에서는 마트에 따라 식비에 연간 약 1310유로 차이가 날 수 있습니다. 2026년 가격 조사를 통해 가장 싼 곳과 가장 비싼 곳을 정리했습니다.
items.title_en: The cheapest supermarkets in Spain in 2026
items.title_original: REVEALED: The cheapest supermarkets in Spain in 2026

items.raw_excerpt: Moving to a new country always comes with a learning curve, but for English speakers in Norway, the local language can lead to some truly surprising and hilarious moments, as Irene Andrade explains.
items.summary_en: Some Norwegian words sound very strange when an English speaker says them. Words like boning and fokk can make people laugh. Writer Irene Andrade explains why these words confuse English speakers so much.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이어 단어 일부는 영어 화자가 소리 내어 읽으면 정말 이상하게 들린다. 'boning'이나 'fokk' 같은 단어는 영어로 읽으면 웃음이 나기도 한다. 글쓴이 이레네 안드라데가 이런 단어가 왜 이렇게 헷갈리는지 설명한다.
items.title_en: Norwegian words that sound wrong in English
items.title_ko: 'boning'부터 'fokk'까지, 영어 사용자를 놀라게 하는 노르웨이어 단어들
items.title_original: From boning to fokk: The Norwegian words that will shock English speakers

items.raw_excerpt: On 14 October, Peniche will bring together tourism experts, researchers and representatives from across Portugal for a conference focused on how destinations can use data to make tourism more sustainable.
items.summary_en: Peniche will host a conference on 14 October. Tourism experts, researchers and representatives from across Portugal will meet to talk about how local places can use data to make tourism more sustainable.
items.summary_ko: 10월 14일 페니체에서 콘퍼런스가 열린다. 포르투갈 전역에서 관광 전문가와 연구자들이 모여 지역이 데이터를 활용해 관광을 더 지속 가능하게 만들 방법을 논의한다.
items.title_en: Portugal to host a tourism data conference in Peniche

items.title_original: Portugal to host conference on the future of sustainable tourism

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) has fined six five-star hotels a total of NT$466,000 (US$14,615) for food safety and hygiene violations, the administration said Wednesday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan fined six five-star hotels a total of NT$466,000, about US$14,615. The Food and Drug Administration said the hotels broke food safety and hygiene rules.
items.summary_ko: 대만 식품약리처가 5성급 호텔 6곳에 음식 안전과 위생 규정 위반으로 합계 46만6000대만(약 1만4615달러)의 벌금을 부과했다.
items.title_en: Six Five-Star Hotels Fined for Food Safety Problems
items.title_original: Six five-star hotels fined for food safety violations: TFDA

items.raw_excerpt: Motorists are advised to exercise caution, due to wet and slippery road conditions.
items.summary_en: Emergency services in Johannesburg urge drivers to be careful because rain has made roads wet and slippery. A severe weather warning is in place for the city. Officials ask people to take extra care on the roads.

items.title_en: Joburg EMS Says Be Careful After Severe Weather Warning
items.title_ko: 악천후 경보 뒤 Johannesburg EMS가 각별히 주의 당부
items.title_original: Joburg EMS urges caution following severe weather warning

items.raw_excerpt: Officials in Brittany have warned that the Saint-Malo area has around 75 days of drinking water left and urged residents to cut back - but with the Route du Rhum set to draw 1.5 million visitors, will there be enough to go round?
items.summary_en: Officials in Brittany say the Saint-Malo area has about 75 days of drinking water left. They ask residents to use less. The Route du Rhum race is expected to bring 1.5 million visitors soon.
items.summary_ko: 브리타뉴 지역 당국은 생마로 주변에 음용수가 75일치밖에 남지 않았다고 밝혔다. 주민들에게 물 사용을 줄여 달라고 요청했다. 곧 열리는 루트 뒤 림 대회에는 150만 명의 관람객이 몰릴 전망이다.
items.title_en: Could Saint-Malo Really Run Out of Water?
items.title_original: Could Saint Malo in 'rainy Brittany' really run out of water?

items.summary_en: Swiss lawmakers want to look at the criminal records of immigrants. Rents in Zurich rose by 3 percent in two years. Here are more short news items from Switzerland.
